beliefs.belief: Didn't hesitate in the tunnels. Doesn't mean he listens.
He listened. Then he asked the right question first. That's twice he hasn't hesitated.
Said it was my protocol and he'd stand behind it. Most officers say that and then present it.
He wants it as the default for anyone, not just Q. Right answer.
Gave my people away across the table without asking me. Right call, wrong order. Told him so.
Took the correction without arguing. Said I'd be asked first. We'll see.
He sent it as mine and put his name under it, and told me he had. He said he'd ask first next time; this is the same thing.
